decisions.reason: Using the client-provided Flat Plan as the arrangement basis does not change the required polished, modern, brand-aligned visual style.
The Flat Plan establishes content arrangement but does not alter the requirement to improve article image quality with AI when necessary.
The arrangement basis does not change the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The Flat Plan does not resume or otherwise change the deferred print-ready output requirement.
The Flat Plan governs article arrangement and does not change the specified website as the source of articles.
The Flat Plan does not change the author-name or circular author-photo requirements for every article.
